plan.title: 为什么清洗后的运动鞋不宜直接贴近暖气烘干？
plan.core_promise: 将快速加热的直觉转为兼顾水分迁移、材料完整性与通风的干燥判断。
plan.primary_carrier: one abstract relationship of a compressed outer field gradually opening into a porous, ventilated inner field

visual_progression.entry: a compact restrained-gray field with short intervals
visual_progression.development: the same field separates into unequal porous layers with widening gaps
visual_progression.resolution: one calm open contained pocket with a dispersed outward edge

must_show: a visible contrast between compact and porous abstract states
one opened path from a contained interior toward dispersed outer space
must_not_imply: a recognizable shoe, heater, fan, product, body part, or literal drying scene
a guaranteed drying duration or material-performance claim
